notes.title: Golden Rails: Harvest of Riddles is out now!
notes.content:
A new adventure awaits in Golden Rails: Harvest of Riddles. Join the dynamic duo, Jack and Jill, once again as they answer the call of another mayor that is seeking help to organize a grand fair.
The mayor has big plans for the town, and it's up to you to assist Jack and Jill in making them a reality. You'll be tasked with transporting the bountiful harvest of vegetables and repairing old railways to ensure the festival's success.
Delve deeper into the story and you'll uncover a web of intrigue and deceit; stumble upon dark secrets; contraband hidden among the cargo; and a conspiracy that threatens the entire festival. 
You, alongside Jack and Jill, will need to piece together the puzzle, find the mastermind behind the scheme, and bring them to justice. 
Golden Rails 6 is an adventure packed with mystery, intrigue, and unexpected twists. Can you uncover the truth and save the day? The time has come to harvest the truth and restore order. Join Jack and Jill in their latest adventure now!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/11774005/e93030f654b71543a393b9fd10e932ea008166cd.png[/img]

[b]GAME FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] 60 levels to complete
[*] 6 levels with mini-game                                                                                                        
[*] Original soundtracks for download
[*] Beautiful desktop wallpapers
[*] Loads of achievements
[*] New mode - search for clues
[*] Unlock improvements and add bonuses to the level
[*] 60 collectible owls
[*] Step-by-step level guide
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690700/Golden_Rails_Harvest_of_Riddles/

notes.title: Golden Rails: Valuable Package is out now!
notes.content:
Join Jack and Jill on an exciting new adventure in the world of postal deliveries! After being chased by bandits and losing some valuable packages, Philip turns to his new friends for help in delivering all the remaining packages to their rightful owners. But it's not just a simple delivery task - the bandits are still on the loose and willing to do whatever it takes to get their hands on the rare and valuable packages.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11774005/12f5a2e517314c4859734e5a374421cf9d55dc94.png[/img]

[b]FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] 45 levels within the time limit + 15 bonus levels
[*] Dozens of achievements 
[*] Collectible owls   
[*] Downloadable soundtracks 
[*] Beautiful desktop wallpapers
[*] New city mode: complete levels and use stars to build and upgrade the city   
[/list]

notes.title: New Yankee: Karma Tales is out now!
notes.content:
A normally-steady stream of silk, spices and other curiosities into Camelot has dried up and it’s down to John, Mary and friends to find out why! What happened to the raja who usually ships these goods? Is he in danger or is there another reason for his disappearance?

notes.title: Brave Deeds of Rescue Team is out now
notes.content:
They're always ready to help. They're always at the heart of the action. They're daring, fearless and resourceful. They are the Rescue Team.

Assemble a team of emergency response specialists and help people in trouble all over the world. With earthquakes, floods, industrial accidents and volcanic eruptions to deal with, there's plenty to keep you occupied!
